changelog: Fixed: the pre-order gate checklist (live journal and backtest ticket both) could grow taller than the screen with nothing to scroll it, pushing the Proceed/Cancel buttons off-screen on a long gate list. The popup now caps at 90vh with only the item list scrolling; each row collapses to a short title with the full rule text behind a '▾' that doesn't also toggle the checkbox. No change to what gets saved.

New FSA Gate 1 structure engine (app/js/structure-gate1.js) -- an exact port of the reference TradingView indicator (FSA_Structure_Gate1.pine v4.2): ATR(14) Wilder RMA, hidden zigzag swing detection, HH/HL/LH/LL labeling, and the BOS/CHoCH state machine. Pure, incremental, no DOM -- pushes one already-closed 4H candle at a time, so lookahead is impossible by construction, not just by convention. 500-candle warm-up on every session open/resume; a rewind resets and replays from the warm-up start rather than patching anything in place.

The replay chart now draws Gate 1 swing labels, BOS (solid) / CHoCH (dashed) lines, and a badge (top-right, exact wording/levels from the Pine indicator) on the existing drawing canvas -- toggleable from the draw toolbar (default on). A forming 4H candle's wick never affects the badge; only its close, once fully revealed in replay time, can.

Every backtest order now records gate1_auto_state (the engine's own reading at order time, sent unconditionally -- independent of whether any checklist appears). When the v3.23.0 gate checklist does open, it gets one extra, always-present 'Gate 1 (Structure)' row pre-checked per the indicator's own direction-aware suggestion (bullish favors longs, bearish favors shorts, unclear favors neither) -- the trader can override it like any other row. gate1_agree (1 = kept the suggestion, 0 = overrode it) is recorded only then. Neither field is ever enforced; gates_passed keeps using the trader's own answers exactly as before.

The session Results page and Saved Backtests summary each gained a 'trader vs indicator agreed/disagreed on gate 1' row, shown only for sessions that actually have gate1_agree data -- reuses the existing per-column metrics renderer, no new UI system.
release_notes: Migration 2026_10_10_0001_add_backtest_gate1_columns.sql: guarded ALTERs adding gate1_auto_state (TINYINT NULL) and gate1_agree (TINYINT(1) NULL) to both trades and backtest_pending_orders, same pattern as every migration since v3.20.3. Candle feed needed no new server endpoint: get_backtest_candles&timeframe=4H with `before` set to the start of the current 4H bucket already skips BacktestController::getCandles()'s own still-forming-bar synthesis (backtestAggregateCandles()), so every row returned is already closed -- js/backtest.js::btRebuildGate1FromScratch()/btAdvanceGate1IfNeeded() just call it with the right window. BacktestController.php: placeOrder() accepts optional gate1_auto_state/gate1_agree, carried through fillPosition() (market) and the pending-order insert (limit); evaluateBar()'s limit-fill branch carries a pending order's own values through to the fill; getResults()/quickResultsSummary() split trades by gate1_agree and reuse backtestMetricsBlock() for the new row group. js/backtest-drawings.js::btRenderGate1Overlay() reuses that file's own btTimeToX/btPriceToY coordinate helpers (gate1 times are raw UTC seconds, converted via toDisplaySeconds() before use, same as every other drawing anchor there). Checklist overflow fix + collapsible row markup is shared via a new checkItemHtml() helper (app/js/app.js), applied to both app/modals/checklist-modal.php/trades.js and app/pages/backtest.php/backtest.js. New app/tests/gate1_parity.js (plain Node/CommonJS self-test, structure-gate1.js exports via a module.exports shim that's a no-op in the browser): a lookahead-proof test that needs no fixture (always runs) plus a fixture-driven parity test against app/tests/fixtures/gate1/*.json (empty as of this release -- reports 'skipped', not a failure, until the trader supplies real Pine-exported fixtures for BTC/LIT/PUMP/LINK; see that directory's README for the expected JSON shape). New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3240.mjs (new mock session 28, an 18-gate-variable strategy to force genuine checklist overflow at both 1366x768 and 1920x1080) -- verifies the overflow fix, badge rendering/toggle, gate1_auto_state present on every order regardless of strategy, gate1_agree correct in both the kept-suggestion and overridden cases, and a byte-identical rewind rebuild. drive-v3230.mjs (v3.23.0's own driver) needed 3 small edits -- an explicit, briefed exception to the usual 'never edit an old driver' rule: its hardcoded checklist item counts (2) are now definitionally wrong, since this release's own approved spec adds a 3rd row (the Gate 1 engine's own) to every gated checklist; only those counts/click-indices changed, nothing else in that file. Every other pre-existing driver (drive.mjs, drive-v3223 through drive-v32210) passes unmodified. backtest_engine.php self-test: 104 passed, 0 failed (unaffected -- no pure-math changed). php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Not yet verified against real data: the parity test's fixture half (no real Pine export supplied yet) and a live BTC 4H side-by-side against the actual TradingView indicator -- both need the trader's own input/browser.
